items.source:
Bind markers can be typically represented as placeholder and identifier.
Placeholders are used within the query to execute so the underlying database
system can substitute the placeholder with the actual value. Identifiers
are used in R2DBC drivers to bind a value to a bind marker. Identifiers are
typically a part of an entire bind marker when using indexed or named bind markers.
items.translation: 绑定标记通常可以表示为占位符和标识符。占位符用于查询中，以便底层数据库系统用实际值替换占位符。标识符在 R2DBC 驱动程序中用于将值绑定到绑定标记。在使用索引或命名绑定标记时，标识符通常是整个绑定标记的一部分。

items.source: Create named BindMarkers using identifiers to bind parameters. Named bind markers can support name hints. If no hint is given, named bind markers can use a counter or a random value source to generate unique bind markers. Allows customization of the bind marker placeholder prefix and namePrefix to represent the bind marker as placeholder within the query.
items.translation: 使用标识符创建命名BindMarkers以绑定参数。命名绑定标记可以支持名称提示。如果未提供提示，命名绑定标记可以使用计数器或随机值源生成唯一的绑定标记。允许自定义绑定标记占位符的prefix和namePrefix，以便在查询中表示绑定标记为占位符。

items.source:
Create anonymous, index-based bind marker using a static placeholder.
Instances are bound by the ordinal position ordered by the appearance
of the placeholder. This implementation creates indexed bind markers
using an anonymous placeholder that correlates with an index.
items.translation: 使用静态占位符创建匿名的基于索引的绑定标记。实例通过占位符出现的顺序进行序数位置绑定。此实现使用与索引相关的匿名占位符来创建基于索引的绑定标记。
